hero.label: Truist Financial
hero.title: Defining the Digital Experience for America's 7th Largest Bank
hero.subtitle: I built a 50-person design organization from a nascent SunTrust UX team, scaling it to around 30 across every line of business and then to 50 through the largest bank merger since 2008, leading business and commercial banking design at Truist.

context.challenge: Scaling a design practice ahead of a $66B merger.
context.scope: All lines of business (SunTrust); Business & Commercial Banking (Truist); Design System
context.body: I inherited a 10-person nascent UX team at SunTrust with no research function and no independent design voice, and established UI and Research as new functions, scaling it to around 30 across Consumer, Small Business, Wealth Management, and Commercial Banking by the time of the $66B merger with BB&T. As that merger created Truist, I continued the build-out to a 50-person design organization and led the UX methodology and design execution for business and commercial banking across the merged entity.
